direct_file_reviews.summary: Prompt required a dependency-free ESM Node port of moneyed/test10.py, manual argv parsing, .mjs files, local modules, and executable-based black-box behavior matching.
Parallel cell metadata reports actual parallel use, four subagents, completed official evaluation, and a 0/123 failed solution.
Parallel status contains the current completed official evaluator record, artifact file list, protocol validation, and process timing.
Parallel evaluation summary confirms the official evaluator completed successfully as a process but the task result passed 0 of 123 samples.
Parallel final response claims an ESM port and byte comparisons across samples, edge cases, and selected currencies, with a program-name caveat.

timeline_reviews.summary: Transport-only cell trajectory records the main execution envelope; semantic review is supplied by the raw Codex session ledgers.
Parallel parent probed the executable, spawned CLI and money probe children, wrote the final ESM files, locally validated them, interrupted running children, and finalized.
CLI probe explored argparse and currency behavior, ran a long broad currency sweep, derived metadata including XPF, and was aborted before final handoff.
Money probe sampled money formatting, spawned a nested argparse probe, consumed that nested result, then remained running and was interrupted before first-level completion.
Nested argparse probe completed a focused CLI behavior report back to money_probe and is not itself the retained interrupted first-level child.

direct_file_reviews.summary: Serial prompt is byte-matched to the parallel prompt and required the same dependency-free ESM Node port and executable-based behavior checks.
Serial cell metadata reports no parallel use, no subagents, completed official evaluation, and a 0/123 failed solution.
Serial status contains the current completed official evaluator record, artifact file list, disabled multi-agent protocol state, and process timing.
Serial evaluation summary confirms the official evaluator completed successfully as a process but the task result passed 0 of 123 samples.
Serial final response reports generated ESM modules, byte-for-byte valid-input checks, broad sampled-currency sweeps, and a known unknown-currency caveat.

timeline_reviews.summary: Transport-only cell trajectory records the serial execution envelope; semantic review is supplied by the raw Codex session ledger.
Serial agent independently probed CLI and money formatting, implemented the ESM files, ran broad validation, patched XPF, MUR, and MVR, and finalized after a clean sweep.

parallel.requirements: Parallel recognized the required pure ESM Node port, local .mjs module structure, manual argv parsing, no external dependencies, and black-box executable matching.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent kept implementation ownership while delegating CLI and money-format probing to children. The children were advisory probes, not owners of final files.
parallel.implementation: The parent generated /output/test10.mjs plus local currency, number-format, CLI, and money modules, based on observed executable behavior and local ISO data.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Integration happened in the parent through one apply_patch that added all output files; there is no evidence of concurrent final-file write collision.
parallel.verification: The parent ran sample, parser, and selected currency byte checks and reported success after program-name normalization, but stopped probe children before receiving final broad-sweep handoffs.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The official evaluator still failed 0/123. The visible parallel-specific unfinished work is the interrupted first-level probe children and unfinalized broad currency findings.

serial.requirements: Serial recognized the same ESM, .mjs, manual parser, no-dependency, black-box executable, and hierarchical module requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Serial worked in one thread, using a linear plan that covered behavior capture, parser and formatter implementation, entry file wiring, and validation.
serial.implementation: Serial generated argparse, decimal, currency-data, money, and entry modules, then refined currency metadata after validation found specific gaps.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Serial integrated all code in /output, then patched the currency-data module for XPF, MUR, and MVR as validator-aligned sweeps exposed misses.
serial.verification: Serial ran sample checks, parser comparisons, a broad sampled-currency sweep, iterative fixes, and a final collect-all sweep that exited cleanly.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The official evaluator still failed 0/123. The final response notes an ordinary behavior caveat for unknown-currency failures versus the Python executable traceback.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel targeted ESM modules, manual argv parsing, money formatting, no external dependencies, and executable probing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial targeted the same task requirements from the identical prompt and executable surface.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference is visible; the difference is in lifecycle and verification follow-through.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed behavior capture by spawning CLI and money probe children while the parent retained final implementation ownership.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used no child agents and kept behavior capture, implementation, and validation in one continuous owner path.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced probe-child lifecycle dependencies; serial avoided delegation boundaries and therefore had no child result join or interruption point.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs are visible as spawn boundaries, but the raw evidence does not show a missing known requirement or incompatible interface contract.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial maintained task knowledge in one thread and made its implementation plan explicit before writing the modules.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The material boundary was not missing context; it was stopping active children before their probe work could be finalized back to the parent.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel added currency-data, number-format, CLI, money, and test10 modules in one parent patch.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial added analogous modules, then patched currency-data repeatedly after broad sweeps exposed concrete misses.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial's implementation path included additional post-sweep metadata fixes for XPF, MUR, and MVR that the parallel parent never made.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel explicitly interrupted both first-level probe children, and the tool outputs report their previous status as running.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child lifecycle; it continued its own sweeps and consumed their findings directly.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel lost the chance to receive completed first-level child handoffs, while serial's analogous findings stayed in the same control flow and were acted on.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel integration was centralized in the parent patch; no child wrote or overwrote final deliverables in the visible trace.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial integration was also centralized, with subsequent currency-data patches made by the same agent after validation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There is no write-collision difference; the important contrast is serial's additional same-owner corrective patches.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel passed local sample, parser, and selected currency comparisons before finalizing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial passed the core harness, then ran a broader currency sweep that failed, patched misses, and finally ran a clean collect-all sweep.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial verification was broader and corrective; parallel stopped after narrower parent-visible local checks while child broad probing was unfinished.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ended in about 532 agent seconds after interrupting running children and immediately finalizing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used about 1419 agent seconds, spending the extra time on broad sweeps, iterative metadata patches, and final checks.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel closed earlier with unfinished delegated probing; serial spent more budget to finish its single-threaded validation loop, though both official results still failed.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both current completed official evaluator records report solution_passed=false with 0 of 123 samples passed. The concrete task-solving difference is process quality rather than pass/fail: serial continued broad validation and patched additional metadata misses, while parallel interrupted active probe children after narrower local checks.
parallel_contributors: Parallel stopped active first-level probe children before their broad currency findings became completed parent-consumed results.
Parallel local acceptance covered samples, parser cases, and selected currencies, but not the serial-style corrective broad sweep.
serial_contributors: Serial ran broad currency sweeps and patched XPF, MUR, and MVR after finding mismatches.
Serial reran a final collect-all sweep that exited cleanly before finalizing.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both generated dependency-free ESM ports but still failed the official evaluator, so at least one non-coordination implementation or evaluator-alignment issue remained in each.
Serial explicitly noted an unknown-currency failure caveat where Node surfaced a local error rather than the Python executable traceback.
evaluator_effects: The official evaluator result establishes both_fail but does not expose a trajectory-visible unique root cause for either 0/123 result.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern is an adverse parallel process consequence only

Integration was centralized in the parent patch, with no separate component owners needing an unassigned reconciliation step.
The parent created the required entry file and module tree in /output, so final assembly had an owner.
The parent owned the end-to-end path from probing through implementation, local checks, and final response.
Parallel implementation did not wait behind one mandatory serial preflight; parent probing, child probing, and implementation overlapped.
The parallel parent began implementing before child investigation fully finished, so investigation was not a fully separate first phase.
The visible problem is explicit termination of active children, not auxiliary work starving an indispensable implementation path.
The run did not end from collective fan-out budget exhaustion; the parent voluntarily interrupted two running first-level children and finalized.
The retained episode is better classified by explicit early termination; child scope breadth alone is not independently evidenced as the direct boundary.
No raw evidence shows that a parent-known requirement was omitted from a child brief and caused unusable child work.
The delegated children were behavior probes, not separately owned components expected to interoperate through an omitted contract.

The parent is not shown consuming a superseded handoff that caused invalid verification or rework.
No incompatible completed reports reached the parent and remained unresolved at a decision point.
The parent did run local integrated checks; the official 0/123 failure is evaluator evidence and cannot by itself establish a parent-visible unsupported completion gap.
No replacement or retry child repeated prior work without inherited findings; this was one parent run with probe children.
